label: to review
Proposed: Mainz
research:
The archival abstract names Dr. Hermann Rosenberg, scholaster of St. Maria ad gradus, among collectors acknowledging a 50-gulden subsidy. His office and contemporaneous colleagues connect him with the same scholaster in 1444-07-06.json and 1457-04-30.json. Bauer (bauer_1872.json) could not place the 1452 scholaster and vicar general in the Franken genealogy and considered non-noble origin possible. The Mainz patrician family is another possibility, but no kinship links him to it. His Mainz office and surname alone do not distinguish either family. The 1449 archiepiscopal register corroborates his office and colleagues: https://www.ingrossaturbuecher.de/index.php?cHash=346098438fe451949fb23ed021a533c4&id=380&tx_hisodat_sources%5Baction%5D=show&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bcontroller%5D=Sources&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bsource%5D=22092. Attribution unresolved. Compare 1444-09-01.json: both are 50-gulden receipts, but their named collectors, notaries, and stated sealers differ; they appear to be separate receipts rather than identical copies, subject to checking the originals. Both abstracts confusingly name Konrad in the heading and Theodor in the body; this discrepancy does not establish a redating.

Further research supports Mainz. The receipt’s name, doctorate in canon law and office as scholaster of Mariengreden identify the cleric whom F. W. E. Roth places in the Mainz patrician Rosenberg family (Archiv für katholisches Kirchenrecht 80, 1900, pp. 189–192, https://archive.org/details/ArchivFuerKatholischesKirchenrecht1900/page/n191/mode/1up). The Erfurt matriculation of Easter 1425 groups Hermanus and Iacobus Rosenberg as de Maguncia (Weissenborn I, p. 131, https://archive.org/details/11698564bsb/page/n162/mode/1up), and the Repertorium Academicum Germanicum lists Hermann as a Mainz patrician (https://resource.database.rag-online.org/ngLB2O476LT2xahbfLkaw). His exact kinship within the Mainz family remains open.

entries.german:
Quittung über 50 Gulden als subsidium extraordinarium an Erzbischof Konrad von Mainz.

Conradus Ruwe, Kantor, Vlricus de Bickenbach, Domkanoniker, Hermannus Rosenberg, decr. Dr., Scholasticus von B. Marie ad gradus intra muros, und Johannes Eckel, Kantor von St. Peter extra muros von Mainz, Commissare und Collectoren der beiden größeren Subsidien und der sechs Procurationen für Erzbischof Theodor von Mainz, quittieren, daß sie von Dekan, Kapitel und Vikaren des Liebfrauenstifts auf dem Berg 50 Gulden erhalten haben.

Siegler: S.: Conradus Ruwe (Rest).Unterschrift von Hermannus Strohod, Notar.

Siegler: S.: Conradus Ruwe (Rest).
Unterschrift von Hermannus Strohod, Notar.
entries.english:
Receipt for 50 gulden as subsidium extraordinarium to Archbishop Konrad of Mainz.

Conradus Ruwe, Kantor; Ulrich von Bickenbach, canon; Hermannus Rosenberg, decr. Dr., Scholasticus of St. Mary ad gradus within the walls; and Johannes Eckel, Kantor of St. Peter outside the walls of Mainz, commissioners and collectors of the two larger subsidies and six procurations for Archbishop Theodor of Mainz, acknowledge that they have received 50 gulden from the dean, chapter, and vicars of the Liebfrauenstift auf dem Berg.

Sealer: S.: Conradus Ruwe (remainder). Signature of Hermannus Strohod, notary.

Sealer: S.: Conradus Ruwe (remainder).
Signature of Hermannus Strohod, notary.
